en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of an ornate building entrance, featuring a grand doorway with an elaborate pediment inscribed with the number '1807'. The facade includes decorative elements such as sculpted cherubs or busts, classical columns, and round windows with ornamental stucco work. The bottom portion of the postcard contains handwritten text in what appears to be German script, along with a printed serial or catalog number (1. W. 2390).
